controls.proposed_control: Verified issuer/audience, secure session lifecycle, step-up for privileged operations.
controls.evidence: Login, recovery, session fixation and revoked-device tests.
All-role data-class matrix with cross-user canaries.

controls.proposed_control: Project/environment isolation, runtime versus migration roles, managed key lifecycle.
controls.evidence: Wrong-project, pool contamination, rotation, KMS outage and restore tests.

controls.proposed_control: Recipient-controlled keys, ciphertext server storage, no server plaintext search or AI.
controls.evidence: Browser/server egress canaries and independent crypto assessment.

controls.proposed_control: Research, preservation, display, identity and endorsement permissions are separate.
controls.evidence: Consent matrix, publication race and derivative withdrawal tests.

controls.proposed_control: Quarantine and sandbox file parsing, no network/macro execution, bounded resources.
controls.evidence: ZIP bomb, path traversal, XML entity, SSRF and converter timeout tests.

controls.proposed_control: Independent state gates, public projection and deny-first withdrawal.
Tamper-evident action records, immutable source lineage, actor and reason attribution.
Restricted defaults, complete redaction and explicit legal/ethical safeguards.
controls.evidence: Hidden text/EXIF/media track and insider access tests.

controls.proposed_control: Read-only tools, permission-first retrieval, no sealed data, bounded provider handling.
controls.evidence: Prompt injection, cross-user retrieval, secret egress and cost ceiling tests.

controls.proposed_control: Least-privilege CI, checked artifacts, actual merge policy and environment isolation.
controls.evidence: Fork secret denial, exact-SHA checks and failed migration drills.

controls.proposed_control: Purpose-based lifecycle, scoped holds, restorable backups and deletion replay.
controls.evidence: Restore after withdrawal, key loss and truncated component tests.
